name: smooth-hold
description: A smooth hold stays put when a long move follows it. Three smooth keys: frames 0 and 16 the same standing pose (root offset [0, 0, 0.945]: the root at (0, -0.0108229, 0.8724043)), frame 60 two hip heights forward (-Y) with the right upper arm turned 90 degrees about X. A Catmull-Rom curve takes its tangent at frame 16 from frames 0 and 60, so between the two equal keys it swung the hips 10.9 cm back (y 0.0979) and moved the arm; clamped tangents are flat at the hold, so frame 8 is frame 0 exactly: the root at (0, -0.0108229, 0.8724043) and the right elbow (lowerarm01.R) at (-0.3294696, -0.0212158, 1.1008943). Frame 38, halfway through the move, is between the keys: y -0.7719249. Physics off.
